content.text: Operations Agent for Pipelines is an AI-powered monitoring agent in Data Factory that continuously watches your pipeline runs and proactively notifies you through Microsoft Teams when failures or anomalies occur. You can configure the agent to monitor specific scenarios such as all pipeline failures or runs exceeding expected durations, without writing custom alerting logic. For more information, see Operations Agent for Pipelines (preview).
